title: World marketing capture manifest (world/demo/capture-manifest/v1)
description: Describes the sibling capture-manifest.json that the attended release capture writes next to the six promoted PNGs. This file is a schema, not a capture record: it carries no hash and no example. Real SHA-256 values come only from the attended capture's own bytes, and the release check (marketingcheck docs --require-assets) refuses any manifest whose hashes do not match them.

frozen-head.description: The frozen public head the six shots were captured from.

sha256.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 of the raw PNG bytes, computed from the attended capture.

route.description: The workbench route the shot was captured from.
